name: maui-unit-testing
description: Add MAUI app tests around ViewModels, services, platform abstractions, and unit/integration/device boundaries. USE FOR: xUnit, avoiding `MauiProgram.CreateMauiApp` in unit tests, fakes/mocks, injectable Essentials interfaces, `PlatformNotSupportedException`, navigation/data services, AppProjectReference, device-test decisions. DO NOT USE FOR: UI automation or profiling.
